title: Priority Selection Heap
summary: Maintain a changing candidate set so the smallest or largest priority item can be removed repeatedly without fully re-sorting the whole set.
recognition_signals: the next item is always the current minimum or maximum
new candidates arrive while selection continues
only the best-priority item needs to be known at each step
core_rules: The heap root represents the current extreme according to the heap's priority order.
Heap insertion and removal restore the partial-order invariant without globally sorting all items.
structural_steps: inspect or pop the root when the next best item is needed

common_confusions.distinction: A queue chooses the oldest arrival. A heap chooses the best current priority.
K-way merge is a specialized priority-frontier pattern where the heap contains one current candidate from each sorted source.
